remarks: Beautifully reimagined modern farmhouse on a quiet Greenwich cul-de-sac, offering 4 bedrooms, 4 full & 1 half baths across four finished levels. Renovated with a timeless coastal feel, featuring wide-plank white oak floors, abundant natural light, town utilities, natural gas, bluestone patios, EV-ready charge & a level backyard with possible pool site. The chef's kitchen, designed by an award-winning designer, offers Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, center island, designer finishes & a custom banquette eat-in area, opening to the family room with fireplace and sliders to the blue-stone patio. The primary suite features two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath with radiant heated floors. Finished lower level offers flexible space. Finished walk-up attic with full bath provides ideal guest or office space. Minutes to Greenwich Ave, train & nature preserve, close to shopping, dining, parks, and nearby schools.
